quotes.quote: The second benchmark, termed Word-Task, aims to examine fine-grained lexical and semantic understanding at the word level.
We introduce two novel internal benchmarks to comprehensively assess the natural language understanding capabilities of LLMs.

The first benchmark, named ComplexNLU, consists of advanced and long-tail reasoning tasks specifically designed to evaluate deeper levels of linguistic comprehension, presenting intricate linguistic structures and sophisticated semantic challenges.
Additionally, we introduce ArtifactsBench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate frontend code generation abilities of LLMs. ArtifactsBench will be made publicly available soon.
